preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.
Number of vertices in each test case is between 3 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: for each test case, the sum of n across all test cases does not exceed 100000
preconditions.description: Total number of vertices across all test cases does not exceed 100000.

preconditions.expression: for each test case, each piece is defined by three distinct integers between 1 and n
preconditions.description: Each piece is defined by three distinct vertices.

preconditions.expression: for each test case, there are exactly n-2 pieces
preconditions.description: There are exactly n-2 triangular pieces.

postconditions.expression: for each test case, the first line of output contains n distinct numbers p1, p2, ..., pn (1 <= pi <= n)
postconditions.description: The first line of output contains the permutation of cake vertices.

postconditions.expression: for each test case, the second line of output contains n-2 distinct numbers q1, q2, ..., q(n-2) (1 <= qi <= n-2)
postconditions.description: The second line of output contains the permutation of cutting order.

postconditions.expression: if the cake vertices are numbered with the numbers p1, p2, ..., pn in order clockwise or counterclockwise, then when cutting pieces of the cake in the order q1, q2, ..., q(n-2) always cuts off a triangular piece so that the remaining part forms one convex polygon
postconditions.description: The permutations p and q satisfy the cutting conditions.
